content: I’ll trace CLI parsing and output-option resolution for color/icons/classify/hyperlinks, then align hyperlink behavior and tests while preserving existing defaults and explicit modes.

The root cause is confirmed: `--hyperlink` is a boolean mapped directly to `On`, unlike the shared `ShowWhen` parser used by color/icons/classify. I’m checking user-facing docs/completions and test conventions before making the cohesive change.

The implementation now preserves no-flag behavior, makes bare `--hyperlink` automatic, supports explicit `always/auto/automatic/never`, and gates automatic links on terminal output. I’ve also updated bundled docs and shell completions; next I’m validating parsing, rendering under a pipe, formatting, and the test suite.

The formatter check passed, but Cargo attempted to refresh the crates.io index and timed out before compiling; no test ran. I’ll switch all Cargo verification to explicit offline mode, first confirming the source state was not altered.

Offline compilation is blocked because the local Cargo cache lacks the locked `cfg-if` package; per the no-network constraint I won’t retry online. I’m adding explicit unit coverage for both accepted auto spellings, then will re-run the available formatting/syntax check and perform a final source review.
